description.value: Sweláps Market is an independent, community-driven full-service grocery store of roughly 22,000 sq. ft., proudly owned and operated by the Tḱemlúps te Secwépemc First Nation. The store carries a full range of departments — bakery, deli, produce, dairy, meat & seafood, and pantry — along with catering services and a loyalty program. Its name honours the bighorn sheep (sweláps) that roam the traditional Secwépemc territory, and the store is open to the entire community.
